cases.title: Employment Reference Letter - Senior Software Engineer
cases.issuing_authority: Apex Technology Solutions Inc. Human Resources Department

fields.benefits: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, 401k employer match, 4 weeks paid vacation
duties_and_responsibilities: Architected and maintained high-throughput microservices using Python and Go.
Led sprint planning sessions and mentored 4 junior developers on best coding practices.
Designed database schemas and optimized SQL queries to reduce latency by 35%.
Engineered CI/CD automation pipelines for continuous deployment to AWS.
fields.company_address: 100 Innovation Way, Suite 400, Toronto, ON M5V 2T6, Canada

narrative_blocks: To Whom It May Concern,
This letter is to confirm that Jane Doe was employed at Apex Technology Solutions Inc. as a Senior Software Engineer from March 1, 2020, through May 31, 2023.
Jane Doe worked on a full-time basis, performing 37.5 hours per week, with an annual base salary of $98,000 CAD along with standard employee benefits including medical coverage and paid vacation.

In her role as Senior Software Engineer (NOC 21232), her primary duties included architecting microservices, leading technical planning sessions, optimizing database queries, and automating CI/CD release pipelines.
If you require further verification or details regarding Jane Doe's employment history, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,
Robert Smith
Director of Software Engineering
Apex Technology Solutions Inc.
